categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches 'Build system' label and directly modifies CMake build scripts to install shell completions alongside binary components.
categories.rationale: Adds CMake installation rules for shell completions so packagers and users do not need to manually copy scripts from contrib/completions/ on install. While a clear convenience for downstream packagers and users (fixing #34714), it does not impact core build integrity, supported-platform availability, or CI reliability.
